title: Library extends evening hours
full_text: The Eastbank library will remain open until 9 p.m. on Tuesdays and Thursdays beginning May 5. The trial runs for eight weeks. The library extended its hours after students and shift workers asked for more time to use the building. During the trial, the main reading room, computers and checkout desk will remain available. The children's activity room will close at its usual time. Staff will count evening visits and ask visitors which services they used. The library board will review those records in July before deciding whether to keep the extended hours.

title: Solar panels start producing power at water plant
full_text: A 240-kilowatt solar installation started producing electricity at the fictional North Marsh water plant on June 3. The electricity feeds pumps and monitoring equipment at the site. The panels sit on two roofs beside the treatment building. The plant will continue to draw power from the grid at night and whenever the panels cannot meet demand. Operators have added a meter to track generation separately from the rest of the plant. They will use its readings to compare output on clear and cloudy days. The plant will publish its first monthly production total after the end of June.

title: Shuttle adds a stop at clinic
full_text: The Westmere community shuttle will add a stop at the outpatient clinic on September 14. The stop will be served on weekday trips between the station and the civic center. Passengers can board at a marked shelter near the clinic's east entrance. The route will keep its existing stops, and the fare will stay the same. The operator plans to check boarding counts and travel times during the first month. Signs at the station and civic center will show where the shuttle stops. Clinic staff will include the updated route information in appointment reminders.
